licensing_table.note: analysis-dependent: under negation with an overt set both the accusative-by-exception reading and the appositive-substitute reading are licensed upstream; neither is preferred and neither certifies
analysis-dependent: reading the built form as occupying an accusative slot, with the excepted noun substituting for it, is an upstream analysis

rules.text: case for the excluded item is read off the cell fixed by clause polarity and by whether the set excluded from is overt; no other feature selects it
the exclusion word never assigns the accusative by itself; with the set omitted the clause role assigns the case
the nominal exclusion words invert the pattern: they carry the case the excluded item would have taken and their complement stays genitive unconditionally
under negation with an overt set both licensed readings survive together, attributed and uncertified
the exclusion-word inventory recorded here is the taught closed set; a word outside it is not licensed by resemblance -> reject_reconstruction
